translations.web: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
translations.bsb: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?
translations.kjv: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
translations.asv: Thou numberest my wanderings: Put thou my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy book?
